title: Turning spectra into images improves plant trait retrieval with 2D-CNNs
abstract: arXiv:2608.16661v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Hyperspectral reflectance spectroscopy enables non-destructive estimation of plant functional traits, yet current deep learning approaches process spectra as one-dimensional sequences, which limits how they capture long-range inter-band dependencies. We asked whether transforming 1D spectra into 2D image representations improves multi-trait prediction with convolutional neural networks (CNN). We compared nine transformations using EfficientNet-B0 on the GreenHyperSpectra dataset (7,897 labeled spectra, eight traits, 400-2450 nm), benchmarked against published 1D CNN results on the same split. Trained from scratch, the simplest transformation, a direct Reshape of the spectrum into a 2D grid, performed best ($R^2 = 0.684 \pm 0.001$) and improved on the state-of-the-art 1D baseline ($R^2 = 0.587$, $+0.097$). translated_title: 将光谱转化为图像可提升二维卷积神经网络在植物性状检索中的表现
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16661v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：高光谱反射光谱学能够实现对植物功能性状的非破坏性估算，然而当前的深度学习方法将光谱视为一维序列，这限制了它们捕捉带间长距离依赖关系的能力。我们探究了将一维光谱转换为二维图像表示是否能改善卷积神经网络（CNN）在多性状预测中的表现。我们使用EfficientNet-B0在GreenHyperSpectra数据集（7,897个标记光谱，八个性状，400-2450纳米）上比较了九种转换方法，并与同一数据划分下已发表的1D CNN结果进行了基准对比。从零开始训练时，最简单的转换——直接将光谱重塑为二维网格——表现最佳（$R^2 = 0.684 \pm 0.001$），并优于现有最优的1D基线（$R^2 = 0.587$，提升了$+0.097$）。随后，我们在139,000个未标记的光谱图像上预训练了一个二维掩码自编码器（MAE-2D）。线性探测（冻结编码器）...
tldr: 本研究通过将一维光谱重塑为二维图像，并利用2D-CNN及自监督预训练，显著提升了植物性状预测精度，超越了传统1D方法。
en_tdlr: This study improves plant trait prediction by reshaping 1D spectra into 2D images and leveraging 2D-CNNs with self-supervised pretraining, surpassing traditional 1D methods.
